headline_claim: FourCastNet matches the forecasting accuracy of the ECMWF Integrated Forecasting System (IFS) ... at short lead times for large-scale variables, while outperforming IFS for small-scale variables, including precipitation; comparable on RMSE and ACC at lead times of up to three days
fixed_metric: YES - ACC/RMSE on Z500, T850, U10, T2m (same 500hPa/850hPa variables as ECMWF series)

headline_claim: for the first time, an AI-based method outperforms state-of-the-art numerical weather prediction (NWP) methods in terms of accuracy ... of all factors ... and in all time ranges (from one hour to one week)
fixed_metric: YES - latitude-weighted RMSE and ACC on geopotential (incl Z500), temperature, humidity, wind at 0.25deg

headline_claim: GraphCast is significantly more accurate than the ECMWF's deterministic forecasting system, HRES, on 89.3% of the 2760 target variables and lead times we evaluated (widely cited as 90% of 1380 verification targets in the paper body)
fixed_metric: YES - RMSE/ACC on standard vars incl Z500, T850; troposphere outperformed on >99% of ~12000 measurements

headline_claim: GenCast was more accurate than ENS on 97.2% of these [1320] targets, and on 99.8% at lead times greater than 36 hours
fixed_metric: YES but PROBABILISTIC - CRPS (ensemble score), not deterministic ACC/RMSE; not directly comparable to the pre-AI HRES ACC series

headline_claim: AIFS produces highly skilled forecasts for upper-air variables, surface weather parameters and tropical cyclone tracks; The AIFS outperforms state-of-the-art physics-based models for many measures ... with gains of up to 20%
fixed_metric: YES - RMSE/ACC vs NWP analyses and observations on standard upper-air vars (Z500, T850 etc), same framework as ECMWF series

headline_claim: This scorecard shows forecast improvements reach up to 25% and that AIFS ENS has higher forecast skill for upper-air variables (overall skill improves 4%-6% in v1.1)
fixed_metric: YES but mixed - CRPS + RMSE/ACC vs IFS ENS on standard vars
